mapper.insert:
insert into sys_notice
title, content, notice_type, level, publish_scope, is_top, need_confirm, publish_time, expire_time, route_path, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
values
#{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{level}, #{publishScope}, #{isTop}, #{needConfirm}, #{publishTime}, #{expireTime}, #{routePath}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now()
mapper.select: select * from sys_notice where `delete` = 0 and status = 'PUBLISHED' and (publish_scope = 'ALL' or notice_id in ( select rel.notice_id from sys_notice_group_rel rel inner join sys_notice_group_member mem on mem.group_id = rel.group_id where mem.user_id = #{userId} ) or notice_id in ( select user_rel.notice_id from sys_notice_user_rel user_rel where user_rel.user_id = #{userId} )) order by is_top desc, publish_time desc, notice_id desc
